title: T-Connector Don’ts
slide_intent: Show where a connecting device breaks down so readers can distinguish meaningful relationships from arbitrary juxtaposition.
strategic_value: Consistent scale, color and content pairing can preserve the clarity of T-Mobile’s connector layout.
demonstration: Four crossed examples reject an oversized crop, repeated T-Digits, a black T and unrelated imagery.
practical_value: Check symbol count, full-height fit, approved color and the reason the two fields belong together.

content_islands.name: Title
content_islands.spec: Place the connector-misuse title at left.

content_islands.name: Scale and repetition failures
content_islands.spec: Pair oversized and repeated connector examples across the upper row.

content_islands.name: Color and content failures
content_islands.spec: Place black-symbol and unrelated-image examples in the lower row.

ingredient.name: T-Connector limits
ingredient.role: Preserve a clear single connection between related fields.
ingredient.application: Do not crop the T-Digit or exceed image height; use one symbol in magenta or white and avoid unrelated image pairs.
ingredient.scope: T-Connector layouts, distinct from other approved large T-Digit applications.
